About Podium Watch

Built for Ohio runners.

Podium Watch covers Ohio high school cross country and track and field with rankings, stories, meet coverage, and athlete interviews.

The goal is simple: give athletes, teams, coaches, and fans one place to follow the sport and celebrate the people who make it special.
